calculation_types_energy._note: Single-point energy calculation. SP is default if no other run type specified.

calculation_types_excited_states._note: Excited-state methods. NOTE: TD-DFT/TDA/CIS/RPA/sTDA/sTDDFT/ROCIS are configured in blocks (%tddft, %cis, %rocis), not on the '!' line — ORCA rejects them as simple-input keywords — so only the ones ORCA accepts on the '!' line are listed. Use the dedicated TD-DFT build mode for excited states.

calculation_types_properties._note: Property calculations. NOTE: EPR/NMR coupling, Mössbauer, polarizability, and hyperfine properties are requested in blocks (%eprnmr, %elprop), not on the '!' line — ORCA rejects those tokens there. Only 'NMR' is a valid '!'-line keyword.

calculation_types_md_dynamics._note: Molecular dynamics. 'MD' runs ORCA's ab-initio MD driver; metadynamics (MTD) is configured inside %md, not as a '!'-line keyword.

calculation_types_combined._note: Common combinations. These are space-separated keyword sequences (ORCA has no single 'OptFreq' token — it rejects it; write 'Opt Freq').
